name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
title: Westlife Foodworld Ltd - 505533 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India, West & South) delivered 1.5% SSSG on mid-single-digit guest count, but supply-side signals are expansion-led (60+ openings FY27) with no capacity discipline; pricing held, margins guided lower to ~67%.

capex.quote: Going forward, we plan to further accelerate our expansion by opening 60 plus restaurants annually

triggers.label: FY27 openings 60+ vs 40-50
triggers.quote: we plan to further accelerate our expansion by opening 60 plus restaurants annually

triggers.label: Guest count mid-single-digit growth
triggers.quote: driven by mid -single-digit guest count growth, which is the real heartening part

triggers.label: No price increase for 4-5 months
triggers.quote: For now, we've not been able to take any price increase for the last four, five months.

triggers.label: Gross margin guided 67%+ near term
triggers.quote: you have mentioned that in the near term the gross margins could be at the 67% plus

guidance.quote: opening 60 plus restaurants annually with all new stores fully equipped
the gross margins could be at the 67% plus
first cross say INR3,000 odd crores in sales
2% to 4% is what we take so that we are able to manage inflation better

red_flags.label: Store closures 6-7 per year
red_flags.quote: we will continue to close six, seven stores because three, four stores automatically comes

red_flags.label: LPG shortage impacting ~10% stores
red_flags.quote: 10% of our stores were impacted pretty much from 10th of March onwards

evasions.quote: I think Rishi, I think this question we can take offline.
on overall business obviously we don't break it out
